note: Trigger replaced 2026-10-29 and the defect is now reached. The old trigger auto-committed its three INSERTs, so sqlite3Fts3PendingTermsClear had already emptied the hash before the SELECT opened. Putting the inserts inside BEGIN is necessary but not sufficient: in 3.22.0 no pending reader that survives across rows ever reads zTerm again -- an exact-term reader snapshots one hash element plus a NULL sentinel (sqlite3Fts3SegReaderPending), and a prefix reader is consumed eagerly by fts3TermSelect and freed before the first row (traced with probes on PendingTermsClear, the zTerm alias and sqlite3Fts3SegReaderFree). The read comes from a RESTART instead: optimize() frees the hash through sqlite3VtabSavepoint -> fts3SavepointMethod -> fts3SyncMethod -> PendingTermsFlush -> PendingTermsClear, then matchinfo() reaches fts3EvalGatherStats -> fts3EvalRestart and re-starts the readers built before the clear. Host ASan (shared/run-host-asan.py, both controls satisfied): heap-use-after-free, a 3-byte read in sqlite3Fts3SegReaderStep under fts3TermSelect <- fts3EvalPhraseLoad, freed by fts3HashFree under sqlite3Fts3PendingTermsClear. Swapping the two aux-function columns, or dropping matchinfo(), is silent.
